newsitem.title: USA: TFC top execs retiring, company sees savings.
newsitem.headline: TFC top execs retiring, company sees savings.

text.p: TFC Enterprises Inc said Wednesday that four of its top executives would retire early as part of a restructuring, and the company would save about $4 million pre-tax on their salaries and benefits.

Retiring effective September 30 are George Kouri, chief executive officer; Joseph Becka, chief marketing officer; Preston Gnagey, chief operations officer, and Charles Johnston, chief financial officer.
All four are under contract through December 31, 1999.
The retirements are part of the company's restructuring plans to reduce operating expenses, TFC said.
It said that in settlement of the contracts of the four, about $1.8 million will be expensed in the third quarter. It estimates pre-tax savings of $4 million on the executives' salaries and benefits.
Chairman R.S. Raley Jr. will assume the duties of chief executive officer and handle the investor and lender relations functions formerly performed by the chief financial officer, TFC said.
The company said it expects completion of its restructuring in the fourth quarter.
